_comment: Example parameter file. The deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) passes parameters INLINE (az deployment group create ... --parameters appName=... image=...), so this file is NOT used by CI — it exists only for manual `az deployment group create --parameters @infra/main.parameters.json`. Replace the SUB placeholder + appName/image for a manual deploy. By default the template now provisions a storage account, Redis cache, and Key Vault (provisionStorage/provisionRedis/provisionKeyVault default true); set those to false to bring your own. alertEmails is empty by default — set it to receive operational alerts.
